description: Authenticate as the JourneyHawk QA superadmin user and capture browser session state for all dependent Praxis journeys

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/auth/login and wait for the login form to fully load
Enter the email address qa-test-journeyhawk@phronex.com into the email field
Enter the password QA_SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD into the password field
Click the Sign In button and wait for the redirect to complete
Verify the URL now includes /praxis/ or the dashboard is visible. Take a screenshot confirming successful login.

description: Navigate to the Praxis dashboard and verify the Life Score, pillar cards, and today's brief summary are rendered — not blank or errored

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/dashboard and wait for the page to fully load (no spinners)
Verify a Life Score is visible — either a numeric score or a placeholder prompting initial setup. Report the value shown.
Verify that pillar indicators (Wealth, Health, Happiness, Wisdom or similar) are visible on the page — as cards, tabs, or labels. Report what is rendered.
Verify the page does NOT show a blank white screen, an unhandled error boundary message, or a 'Something went wrong' overlay.
Take a full-page screenshot of the dashboard

description: Navigate to the Habits page, verify the habit list renders, and log a habit — confirming the streak counter updates

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/habits and wait for the page to fully load
Verify the page renders either a list of habits (with names and streak indicators) OR a meaningful empty state with a CTA to add a first habit. Report which state is shown.

If at least one habit is visible: click the log/check-in button for any habit. Verify the UI responds — a checkmark, completion indicator, or success message appears. If no habits exist: click any 'Add Habit' or 'Create Habit' button, fill in a name (e.g. 'QA Test Habit'), and submit. Verify the new habit appears in the list.
Take a screenshot showing the logged habit or the newly created habit

description: Navigate to the Habits page Eisenhower Matrix view and verify habits can be seen in quadrant layout

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/habits and wait for the page to load
Look for an Eisenhower Matrix tab, toggle, or view button. Click it if visible. If no explicit toggle exists, look for Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 quadrant labels on the page.
Verify the quadrant view renders — four labelled quadrants (Urgent+Important, Not Urgent+Important, etc.) are visible. Report the labels shown.
Take a screenshot of the quadrant/Eisenhower view

description: Navigate to the Finance page Portfolio tab and verify portfolio holdings and net worth are rendered or have a meaningful empty state

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/finance and wait for the page to fully load
Verify the Portfolio tab is visible. Click it if not already active.
Verify the portfolio section renders either a table/list of holdings OR a meaningful empty state (e.g. 'No holdings added yet' with a CTA). Report which state is shown.
Look for a Net Worth indicator anywhere on the page — a number, chart, or label. Report whether it is visible.
Take a screenshot of the Finance page

description: Navigate to the Finance Expenses tab and verify expenses section renders or has a meaningful empty state

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/finance and wait for the page to load
Click the Expenses tab (or Spending tab if labelled differently)
Verify the expenses section renders — either a list of expense entries, a chart, or a meaningful empty state. Report what is shown.
Take a screenshot of the Expenses tab

description: Navigate to the People page and verify the contact list renders with cadence status indicators

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/people and wait for the page to fully load

Verify the page renders either a contact list with names and last-contact indicators OR a meaningful empty state with a CTA to add contacts. Report which state is shown and how many contacts are visible.
Verify the page does NOT show an error boundary or 'Something went wrong' message.
Take a screenshot of the People page

description: Navigate to the Life/Goals page and verify milestones or goals are rendered or have a meaningful empty state

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/life and wait for the page to fully load
Verify the page renders either life goals/milestones content OR a meaningful empty state. Report what is visible.
Verify the page does NOT show a blank white screen or unhandled error.
Take a screenshot of the Life/Goals page

description: Navigate to the morning brief or briefs section and verify a brief is displayed or the empty state for no briefs is meaningful

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/dashboard and look for a morning brief section, or navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/review if there is a dedicated brief/review page. Wait for the page to load.
Verify the brief section renders — either a today's brief with content, a 'brief will arrive at 7am' message, or a list of past briefs. Report what is shown.
Verify no error boundary or blank state appears where brief content should be.
Take a screenshot of the brief section

description: Navigate to the User Assessment page and verify the assessment UI loads correctly — either showing results or prompting to take the assessment

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/assessment and wait for the page to fully load
Verify the page renders one of: (a) a completed assessment with persona/score, (b) an assessment questionnaire ready to answer, (c) a CTA to start the first assessment. Report which state is shown.
Verify no error boundary, blank white area, or 'Something went wrong' appears.
Take a screenshot of the Assessment page

description: Navigate to Praxis settings and verify the settings page renders with configurable options

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/settings and wait for the page to fully load
Verify the settings page renders — showing tabs, sections, or form fields for configuring Praxis. Report the main sections visible (e.g. profile, notifications, pillars, billing).
Verify no error boundary or blank area appears.
Take a screenshot of the Settings page

description: Navigate to the Coach (AI Goal Coaching) page and verify the chat interface renders and is interactive

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/coach and wait for the page to fully load
Verify the coach/AI chat interface renders — a message thread area and an input field or send button should be visible. Report what is shown.
Verify no error boundary or blank white screen appears where the chat should be.
Take a screenshot of the Coach page

description: Navigate to the Knowledge/Wisdom page and verify content or vault renders correctly

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/knowledge or http://localhost:3002/praxis/wisdom and wait for the page to load
Verify the page renders — either a list of knowledge items/vault entries, a search bar, or a meaningful empty state. Report what is visible.
Verify no error boundary or blank area appears.
Take a screenshot of the Knowledge page

description: Navigate to the Calendar page and verify calendar events or empty state renders without error

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/praxis/calendar and wait for the page to fully load
Verify the calendar interface renders — a date grid, week view, or list of events. Report what view is shown and whether any events are displayed.
Verify no error boundary, blank white screen, or 'Failed to load calendar' message appears.
Take a screenshot of the Calendar page
